quote: Taken together, these results on neuroimaging data across disease stages suggest that cMD is more sensitive than CTh to track early signs of cortical injury prior to overt loss of grey matter, with greatest sensitivity in C9orf72 mutation carriers (starting at GENFI-CDR = 0), followed by MAPT carriers (starting at GENFI-CDR = 0.5), and only from late stages (GENFI-CDR ≥ 1) in GRN carriers.

design: étude transversale avec suivi clinique longitudinal

design: étude transversale avec suivi clinique longitudinal
